readiness_reason: Repository-specific acceptance criteria, application test suite and digest-pinned credential-free offline image have not yet been executed and verified.

review_criteria.requirement: Preserve the authorized task, applicable repository/ADR instructions and fixed approved baseline; report omitted mandatory criteria or ambiguity as needs_review.
Preserve required application test/CI checks and safety boundaries; distinguish executed offline evidence from live behavior and unverified claims.
Independently assess findings and rebuttals on the same candidate; do not auto-merge, force-push, weaken criteria, count silence as consensus or retry failed/crashed attempts implicitly.
When approved criteria or evidence cannot determine a safe choice, visibly notify the owner and stop until recorded authorized direction and fresh review.
